protocol: Nested CV: outer stratified 5-fold (seed 42, same splits as v1); inner stratified 3-fold for all scaling, feature selection and hyperparameter search. Neural models: max 1000 epochs, early stopping (patience 50). Preprocessing v2: motion correction, Friston-24 regressors, FD scrubbing, high-variance confounds, Schaefer-100 and Schaefer-200.

binary_diagnostic.finding: The v1 binary signal (LR AUC 0.745) does not survive cleaning: v1 method on v2 features gives AUC 0.480, while v2 method on v1 features gives AUC 0.689, so the difference is the cleaned features, not the method. Mean head motion alone is barely predictive (AUC 0.523), so the removed signal was motion/physiological noise in the connectivity, not raw head movement. The 3-class signal is real and improved with cleaning (LR 0.319 to 0.502). The best v2 binary model is XGBoost on Schaefer-200 (AUC 0.689).
